title: Dynamic Persona Gating
summary: This module orchestrates multi-round agent interactions, dynamically applying and adjusting persona gates based on model output. It streams responses token-by-token, providing a detailed trace of the agent's decision-making process.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Gated Agent Turn
nodes.title: Gated Agent Turn Stream
nodes.description: Manages multi-round agent interactions, dynamically applying and adjusting persona gates based on model output, streaming results and trace information to the client.

nodes.label: Calculate Gate Contributions
nodes.title: Gate Contribution Calculation
nodes.description: Determines the steering vectors (contributions) for active persona gates based on current settings, trait alphas, and the persona bundle, influencing model behavior.

nodes.label: Generate Steered Response Stream
nodes.title: Steered LLM Response Generation
nodes.description: Generates a token-by-token stream of LLM responses, applying persona steering vectors derived from active gates to guide the model's output towards specific traits.

nodes.label: Generate Plain Response Stream
nodes.title: Plain LLM Response Generation
nodes.description: Generates a token-by-token stream of LLM responses without any persona steering applied, serving as a baseline or when no gates are active.

nodes.label: Parse Gate Toggle Commands
nodes.title: Extract Gate Toggles
nodes.description: Analyzes the LLM's generated text to identify and extract explicit commands for toggling persona gates, enabling dynamic adjustment of persona during interaction.

nodes.label: Apply Gate Toggles
nodes.title: Update Active Gates
nodes.description: Modifies the list of active persona gates based on the parsed toggle commands from the model's output, changing the agent's persona for subsequent turns.

nodes.label: Format Gate Tool Message
nodes.title: Prepare Tool Result Message
nodes.description: Constructs a structured message summarizing the current state of persona gates, intended for the LLM as a tool result to inform its next generation.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: Pre-trained Language Model
nodes.description: The underlying large language model (e.g., HuggingFace PreTrainedModel) used for generating text responses, central to the agent's conversational abilities.

nodes.label: Model Tokenizer
nodes.title: AutoTokenizer
nodes.description: The tokenizer responsible for converting text to token IDs and vice-versa for the language model, crucial for processing input and output.

nodes.label: Compute Device
nodes.title: Torch Device
nodes.description: Specifies the hardware device (CPU, GPU) where model computations are performed, optimizing performance for large language models.

nodes.label: Data Type
nodes.title: Torch Data Type
nodes.description: Defines the numerical precision (e.g., float32, bfloat16) for model tensors, impacting memory usage and computational speed.

nodes.label: Yield Streamed Output
nodes.title: Iterator Output Stream
nodes.description: An iterator that yields dictionary chunks containing model responses, banners, and trace information, allowing clients to display real-time progress.

groups.label: Surface API
groups.title: User-Facing Entry Point
groups.description: The primary function exposed by this module for initiating and managing dynamic persona-gated agent turns, streaming the interaction.

groups.label: Generative Components
groups.title: LLM Interaction & Response Generation
groups.description: Components responsible for interacting with the underlying Large Language Model to generate responses, either with or without persona steering applied.

groups.label: Analytical Logic
groups.title: Persona & Output Analysis
groups.description: Functions that analyze current persona states, process model outputs for gate changes, and prepare structured messages for internal communication or model input.

groups.label: Data & Resources
groups.title: Core Data Structures & External Resources
groups.description: Represents the essential external resources and data types required for the module's operation, including the LLM, tokenizer, and hardware configurations.
